generation_settings.grammar:
root ::= "{" space tool-kv space "}"
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
tool ::= ("\"logistics.trace_shipment\"" | "\"logistics.reroute_shipment\"" | "\"logistics.estimate_delivery\"" | "\"addresses.validate\"" | "\"customs.declare_value\"" | "\"labels.generate\"" | "\"couriers.list_rates\"" | "\"escalations.open_case\"")
tool-kv ::= "\"tool\"" space ":" space tool

http.prompt:
Known: order ORD-3319, customer C-303, sku SKU-7743, tracking TRK-73002.
Available tools:
- logistics.trace_shipment: 追踪物流 / trace a shipment (params: tracking_no)
- logistics.reroute_shipment: 改派物流 / reroute a shipment (params: tracking_no)
- logistics.estimate_delivery: 预估送达 / estimate delivery (params: tracking_no)
- addresses.validate: 校验地址 / validate an address (params: address_id)
- customs.declare_value: 申报价值 / declare customs value (params: tracking_no, amount)
- labels.generate: 生成面单 / generate a label (params: order_id)
- couriers.list_rates: 查询运费 / list courier rates (params: zone)
- escalations.open_case: 开升级单 / open an escalation case (params: tracking_no)
Check whether address ADR-449 is deliverable. 只回答要调用的工具名。 / Answer with the tool name only.
Respond with the answer only, no explanation.
